# Hello and welcome to my website!

::: {style="text-align: justify;"}
I am Menasha Senanayaka, who is passionate in research and eager to use statistical methods to solve problems. A hard-working, responsible, adaptable, and fast-learning individual who has specialised statistics. Keen in searching for new concepts in the field of statistics and contributing to research. Interested in statistics and machine learning. I am looking forward for my higher studies and research journey.

On this website, I offer a glimpse into my knowledge by sharing some of my work which includes  <a href="https://menashabs.github.io/1_projects/">**Projects**</a>, <a href="https://menashabs.github.io/2_experience/" target="_blank">**Experience**</a>, <a href="https://menashabs.github.io/3_workshops/" target="_blank">**Workshops**</a> and <a href="https://menashabs.github.io/4_blogposts/" target="_blank">**Blog Posts**</a>.

Feel free to <a href="https://menashabs.github.io/5_contact/">**contact**</a> me for any inquiry, comments or statistical consultancy. 



:::

## Statistical Consultancy Platform

::: {style="text-align: justify;"}
I am the founder of **Brainy Stat**, an online statistical consultancy platform providing teaching, statistical consultancy, and data analysis services for students, graduates, professionals, and organizations.

Through Brainy Stat, I aim to make statistics more accessible and practical by providing statistical education, guidance, and support for academic, research, and data-driven projects.

* **Brainy Stat** – Statistical consultancy, teaching, and data analysis platform | <a href="https://brainystatisticswork.netlify.app" target="_blank">Visit Website</a> <br>

* **LinkedIn** – Professional updates, services, and educational content | <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/brainy-stat/" target="_blank">Visit LinkedIn Page</a>
